data.desc: Rantizo (Nasdaq: RNTZ), headquartered in Houston, Texas, is an American drone company developing and commercializing heavy-lift autonomous drones and drone-based services for precision agriculture, forestry and wildfire response, infrastructure inspection and specialized government applications. Its platforms include the Harvest 100 agricultural drone, the Titan firefighting and forestry drone and a long-range fixed-wing surveillance prototype, supported by agricultural spraying services and by purchase, lease and financing options. The Company also operates an established civil engineering business in Singapore.
